The Classification of membership are as follows:-

(i)
General members:- Entry fee and the monthly
membership  fee  shall  be  paid  (can  be  paid
monthly  or  annually).  Society  Maintenance
fee  and  the  welfare  fee  shall  be  paid  on  a
decision made at the general meeting.

(ii)
Life  members:-  Entry  fees  and  the  life
membership fees shall be paid at once. Society
Maintenance fees and the welfare fees shall
be  paid  on  a  decision  made  at  the  General
Meeting.

(iii)
Honorary  members:-  Entry  fees  or  the
membership fees will not charged. Any person
who has done a great service to the Buddha
Sasana and is qualified to be a member if the
Society,  is  entitlied  for  the    honorary
membership upon a resolution passed by the
votes  of  two  third  (2/3)  of  members.  The
honorary members shall not be more than five
(05) members. The persons who are granted
the  honorary  membership,  are  entitled  for
membership rights.
